inspection.scope: Symmetric-phase minimal triplet LR gauge/matter definition, parity/C implementation; selected surrounding paragraphs only. Not a full phenomenology reread.

claims.locator: Section 2, PDF/printed p.4, opening paragraph before Eq.(1)
claims.value: SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R x U(1)_(B-L); colour explicitly suppressed, not absent.

claims.locator: Section 2, PDF/printed p.4 Eq.(1); p.7 Eq.(16) and paragraph below
claims.value: Q_(L,R)=(u,d)_(L,R), l_(L,R)=(nu,e)_(L,R); Q_R charge conjugate is explicitly a left-chiral spinor.

claims.locator: Section 2, PDF/printed p.4 paragraph before Eq.(3) and Eq.(3)
claims.value: One Phi in (2,2,0); Delta_L in (3,1,2), Delta_R in (1,3,2), in source B-L units.

claims.locator: Section 2, PDF/printed pp.4-6 Eqs.(3),(5),(8), heavy-Higgs paragraph and Eq.(15)
claims.value: Phi is an unconstrained complex bidoublet: source has two SU(2)_L doublets and a complex heavy neutral component, not a single real bidoublet. Delta_L/R are complex since their continuous B-L charge is nonzero. No dependent conjugate multiplets are counted.

claims.locator: Section 2, PDF/printed p.5 generation-indices sentence after Eq.(8); p.6 Eq.(11); section 4.1, PDF/printed p.22 Flavor structure
claims.value: Eq.(11) enumerates u,c,t and d,s,b in both chiralities, fixing three quark families. p.22 explicitly describes the three nu_R mass eigenstates; combined with Eq.(1), the lepton doublets have three copies.

claims.locator: Section 2, PDF/printed p.4 explicitly suppresses colour; p.4 Eq.(1); p.4 Eqs.(3)-(4)
claims.value: Restore the ordinary SM colour algebra su(3), fundamental quarks and singlet leptons/Higgs. This is expansion of the paper's explicitly suppressed ordinary colour sector using the atlas SM baseline, not a new colour tuple printed by P04. No global quotient is asserted.

Using the ordinary identified u,d charges 2/3,-1/3 and nu,e charges 0,-1, Eq.(2) gives source B-L=1/3 for Q_L/R and -1 for l_L/R. The opposite SU(2) factor acts trivially. These charges are derived, not a fermion charge table quoted from P04.

One positive primitive scale 3 over fermions AND scalars: q=3(B-L). Source Q_R,l_R convert to LH conjugates with colour conjugation and charges -1,+3; triplets have +6. The source coupling on p.5 multiplies (B-L)/2, so g_atlas=g_source/6 if that covariant-derivative convention is retained.

P exchanges Q_L and Q_R and maps Phi to Phi^dagger; C exchanges Q_L with (Q_R)^c and maps Phi to Phi^T. Hermitian versus symmetric Yukawa restrictions differ. Both use the same gauge/matter inventory, hence ONE staged field-content candidate with two source variants.

old_extraction_gaps_resolved: Suppressed colour sector explicitly identified and restored with a declared SM baseline.
Opposite SU(2) singlets, full fermion B-L charges, three-family counts and scalar reality established.
Whole-spectrum primitive integer unit replaces legacy source:2 scalar display with q=6.
R-handed quarks become LH anti-colour doublets, not merely charge-sign flips.
remaining_limitations: Source evidence is agent checked, not independently reviewed.
Ordinary SM colour/electric-charge baseline is explicitly inherited, not re-enumerated by P04.
Scalar-realification equivalence and general multi-U1 basis canonicalization are not implemented.
No source or website database is changed; reconciliation with legacy LR entry requires a curator.
inspection_coverage_note: Listed text pages identify inspected passages, not necessarily every sentence; visual pages were rendered and inspected as complete pages. Whole-paper read remains false.

duplicate_check.action: Review candidates and incomplete records before adding an entry. No exact match does not prove novelty.
duplicate_check.limits: Field-content identity only, not physical-theory equivalence. General U(1) basis mixing, simple-algebra outer automorphisms and different regimes require reconciliation. This is not an SM-embedding, anomaly or viability check.

reconciliation.policy: A newly complete correction is NOT a new model just because the old incomplete registry has no exact signature. Reuse the known legacy entry after review.

measurement.notes: Exact model token/billing/GPU telemetry and active-reading time are not exposed. UTC observations include orchestration and other work; never infer tokens from source words.
